card.architecture: Boogu-Image-0.1 10B unified DiT edit model (Qwen3-VL encoder, FLUX.1 VAE); Apache-2.0; bf16 (full precision)
card.summary: Brand-new (0.1) Apache-2.0 unified edit model. Instruction editing via the native TextEncodeBooguEdit node: vision tokens drive the change, a reference latent preserves identity. Real CFG (~5). Runs bf16 on 24 GB (encoder offloads before sampling). Single reference image in the 0.1 release.
use_cases: instruction editing: insert/replace/remove objects, attribute & material changes
background and scene replacement, style transfer keeping subject coherence
card.pick_when: You want to try the new Boogu edit model on a single-image instruction edit; commercial OK; have a 24 GB card.

prompt.guidance: Provide an input image + imperative instruction.
prompt.example: (with input image) Change the background to a snowy forest at dusk
prompt.overview: Plain natural-language edit instructions (English or Chinese). The vision tower reads your image at low res for understanding while a 1K reference latent preserves identity, so describe the change clearly and let the model keep the rest.
prompt.instructions: Write a plain add/remove/change instruction (EN or ZH). Recommended (model card): 25-50 steps, CFG (text guidance) 2.0-5.0 (5.0 is a good default), empty negative prompt. Strong on single-image edits and bilingual text editing; identity/layout preservation is 'not yet stable enough' per the authors, so keep instructions focused. The reference image is auto-resized to ~1K internally.
do: Write a clear add/remove/change instruction (EN or ZH)
Keep to one focused edit at a time
Quote exact text for text edits
Leave the negative empty unless you need to suppress something
dont: Cram several unrelated edits into one instruction
examples: Replace the red car with a blue bicycle.
Add falling snow and change the lighting to dusk.
Change the sign text to 'OPEN' keeping the same font and color.
prompt.negative_guidance: The model card recommends an empty negative prompt; the encode node maps an empty negative to its DROP path, leaving CFG clean.

speed.note: 10B bf16; the fp8 text encoder offloads before the diffusion model loads so it fits unquantized on 24 GB.
speed.measured_note: Not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Edits an existing image from an instruction; not used for from-scratch generation here.
ui_help.good_for: trying the new Boogu edit model on single-image instruction edits

edit_use_cases: single-image instruction editing on the new Apache-2.0 Boogu 0.1 base: object insert/replace/remove, attribute/material, background/scene, style transfer, bilingual text

reference.hint: The 0.1 Edit release works from a single image (your photo); additional reference images are not supported yet.
